source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
This part of the [team pairing system](vsdata:core-rule/event-companion.pairing-system) uses 3 secret picks, each revealed by both teams at the same time:

1. Each team picks 1 member as its Defender.
2. Each team picks 2 other members as Attackers to face the opposing Defender.
3. Teams choose which of the 2 opposing Attackers their Defender will play. This sets 2 games.

Each Defender then picks a layout. The 2 refused Attackers play each other, using Layout A in round 1, B in round 2 and C in round 3, then repeating that cycle.
